purpose: Provider-neutral registration and runtime envelope for EKODI and external implementations of the same capability.

rules: implementationId is unique within one capability
capabilityId is stable across compatible implementations
external implementations never inherit EKODI private database access
provider-specific credentials remain behind the owning adapter or gateway
context_projection contains only the minimum purpose-bound data required for the operation
canonical secrets and reusable provider credentials are forbidden
workspace context is authorized by EKODI before an external implementation is invoked
high-impact actions carry explicit approval state when required by policy
provider_metadata must not expose reusable credentials or private provider topology
evidence and provenance are retained when the capability requires verifiable outputs
partial and unavailable states are first-class results and may trigger fallback
